标题: About Nex | Building Active Play for Families
文案内容:
[H1] We’re a team of dreamers and doers.
We're a team of parents, engineers, and second-time entrepreneurs who've helped build products at Apple, Google, Microsoft, and Meta. Backed by world-class partners across sports, entertainment, and gaming, we're building joyful active play experiences that get families moving, laughing, and making memories every day.
[H2] We started a movement, all about movement.
Since 2017, we've been chasing a big idea: what if technology could get us off the couch instead of keeping us there? From sports training to active gaming, our journey has been one of dreaming, experimenting, and learning. Every step reinforced what we believed from the beginning: movement is better together. Nex Playground is the fullest expression of that vision yet.
2017 The seed for Nex is planted by connecting technology to our passion for being active together (pickup basketball!).
2018 We make sports training more joyful and interactive with HomeCourt, an AI basketball-training app using motion tracking on iPhone — and demo it on the Apple keynote stage with investor and two-time NBA MVP Steve Nash.
2019 We partner with the NBA to bring more accessible tools, training, and confidence to aspiring athletes. HomeCourt is named Time Magazine Invention of the Year and wins an Apple Design Award.
2020 When the pandemic shuts down basketball — and everything else — we help people stay active at home. Fast Company names us a Most Innovative Company in Sports.
2021 We apply our motion-tracking technology to fitness, and Active Arcade is born — interactive physical games that started as sports-training ideas in HomeCourt.
2022 We discover active games are even better when they bring families together around the TV. Active Arcade is named an Apple Design Awards finalist for Innovation.
2023 Our vision is fully realized in Nex Playground, a new kind of platform built for joyful, movement-based play. Playground is named Time Magazine Invention of the Year (again) and Parents magazine Toy of the Year.
2024 We launch Playground at Amazon, Target, Walmart, Best Buy, and Sam’s Club — and sell out for the holidays.
2025 Playground makes moving together a joyful part of every day. And we’re just getting started.
PLAYGROUND FOR GOOD
[H2] We want everyone to play.
We started Playground for Good because we deeply believe in the transformative power of play. In an effort to bring active fun where it can do the most good, we’re donating Nex Playground to:
children’s hospitals Local libraries Community centers playground for good PEDIATRIC ADVISOR
[H2] We take play seriously.
Meet Dr. Emily Greenwald, our Chief Pediatric Advisor. Together, we’re making sure the evolution of Nex Playground is rooted in science. Because play isn’t just recreational, it’s foundational to a child's physical, emotional, and developmental well-being.
[H2] Come play with us.
We believe big ideas come from curious minds given the freedom to explore. So, we've created a culture where passionate people can do their best work and have a little fun along the way. Want to join us?

标题: Careers | Nex
文案内容:
[H1] Pursue your passion
At Nex, we aspire to solve big problems and serve humanity. To do that, we cultivate a culture of freedom and exploration to invent truly great products. Together, we are a collective of passionate people who share a common purpose. To help humanity reconnect with the joy of movement.
Join the Fun See Open Roles HOW WE WORK
[H2] Both free and flexible.
[H3] We’re global, local, and remote!
Our team spans multiple countries and time zones, with hubs in San Jose, Seattle, and Hong Kong and teammates working remotely around the world. We value the flexibility of distributed work while making time to connect in person when it matters. Great ideas aren't limited by geography.
[H3] Teams with ownership.
We give people the autonomy to make decisions, take initiative, and see ideas through. Teams own what they build from shaping the idea to shipping, learning, and improving it. We trust people closest to the problem to solve it, not wait for permission.
[H3] Diversity makes us stronger.
We build products for all kinds of families, and we believe our team should reflect the diversity of the families we serve.
[H3] It’s ok to work different.
There's no single way for doing great work. Some people do their best thinking from home, others thrive in the office, and many prefer a mix of both. We trust people to work in the ways that help them do their best.

Analytics data from the Nex Playground device is not linked to or combined with data collected through our website, e-commerce platform, or Play Pass subscription system.

Age Rules and Parental Consent
Nex Playground is designed for family use. For COPPA compliance, users under 13 in the United States require verifiable parental consent before we collect personal information beyond what is permitted under the internal operations exception. For EU and UK users:
Our platform requires parental account set-up and consent before a child’s account is activated. If we discover that a child’s data has been collected without appropriate consent, we will delete it promptly.
Parental Consent

On Nex Playground, a limited set of technical data (device identifier and device vitals) is collected from first boot solely under the COPPA internal operations exception (16 C.F.R. §312.5(c)(7)) and, for EU users, under a documented Legitimate Interests basis (GDPR Art. 6(1)(f)). Following device setup and account sign-in, we present a data collection consent prompt. (For more information, please see Persistent Identifier – Internal Operations Exception below). Where a parent or user consents, analytics collection continues under GDPR Art. 6(1)(a). Where consent is declined, no further analytics events are transmitted and any pre-consent data associated with that device is deleted. Parents or guardians may review the personal information collected from their child, request deletion of that information, and withdraw consent at any time by contacting us at support@nex.inc.
How Consent Works and How to Withdraw
Consent is recorded with a timestamp, the version of the consent prompt shown, and the parental account ID. To withdraw consent at any time, parents may contact support@nex.inc. Upon withdrawal, analytics collection will cease and any pre-consent data associated with that device will be deleted.

We do not collect names or contact information on Nex Playground. No information from Nex Playground that could be used to directly identify a child is shared with independent third parties for commercial or advertising purposes.

On Nex Playground, we collect certain persistent identifiers and technical telemetry data from first boot to support internal operations of the Services. Specifically: (a) a persistent device identifier is transmitted to Mixpanel for internal analytics and product support, as permitted under COPPA (16 C.F.R. §312.5(c)(7)); and (b) device vitals and firmware error telemetry are transmitted to Memfault for device stability and crash diagnostics, as permitted under COPPA and, for EU users, under GDPR Art. 6(1)(f) Legitimate Interests documented in our Legitimate Interests Assessment (LIA). “Internal operations” means activities necessary to maintain or analyze the functioning of the Services, perform network communications, authenticate users or devices, ensure legal or industry compliance, and fulfil a request made by a child that is consistent with our parental consent obligations. Following sign-in, users are presented with a data collection consent prompt; where consent is given, analytics collection continues under GDPR Art. 6(1)(a); where consent is declined, pre-consent analytics data is deleted. Please be aware that no security measures are perfect or impenetrable. We cannot and do not guarantee that information about you will not be accessed, viewed, disclosed, altered, or destroyed by breach of any of our physical, technical, or managerial safeguards.
Data Breach Notification

Where the breach is likely to result in a high risk to you, we will also notify you directly without undue delay (GDPR Art. 34). To report a security concern or potential breach, please contact: security@nex.inc.
Changes and Updates to this Policy

If we make material changes, we will notify you via email or a prominent notice on our Services before the change takes effect, and we will indicate the date of the latest revision at the top of this Policy. THIRD-PARTY VALIDATED
[H2] Don't just take our word for it.
Playground is kidSAFE+ COPPA certified, which means the entire platform—and all our games—meet strict safety and privacy standards for kids under 13. And thanks to our commitment to keeping the internet a safe place, we’re also members of the Family Online Safety Institute (FOSI).
[H3] Your living room. Your rules. Your peace of mind.
The camera on Playground makes it possible to play using only your body. That’s its only job. No video or audio is saved or stored. So, you can be sure your best moves won’t ever leave your living room. And when playtime is over, the camera cover gives you added peace of mind.
[H3] A cube so smart it doesn’t rely on the cloud.
While you’re high-kicking your way to victory, Playground uses AI motion tracking to make your movements feel like magic. And all that magic happens right on your device, never “in the cloud.” The only time you even need to be connected to WiFi is to download games and updates. Otherwise, you can play totally offline.
[H3] The only thing you have to worry about is too much laughter.
Every game and activity on Playground is made by Nex, so you can be sure they’re designed to be kid-safe and family‑friendly. There’s no app store, no mature or inappropriate content, and all games are appropriate for all ages.
[H3] No ads, no nags–the way playtime was meant to be.
Nex Playground is a completely ad-free zone. In addition to the peace that brings, it also means there’s no need for us to collect any personal data about you or your kids.Bonus: with Play Pass, you won’t be asked to make any additional purchases.
[H2] The nitty-gritty, never-be-afraid-to-ask questions.
Can my kids play or chat with strangers online? That’s a big nope. Because there is no browser, no chat or messaging, and no third-party apps, the only people your kids will be interacting with is whoever they’re playing with in person. In fact, the only time you even need to be connected to WiFi is to download games and updates. Otherwise, you can play totally offline.
If there's no one watching, why is there a camera cover? The camera cover is really just for extra peace of mind when playtime is over. Plus, we think the cube looks pretty cute with it on.
How does motion tracking work without recording video data? Al motion tracking happens locally on the device. Video data is not processed on the cloud. Some games temporarily record video for local replay and highlights (Move and Groove with Grover and Party Fowl, for example), but those videos are never saved.
Why aren't there any parental controls? That's because all of our games and content are created for kids first.
They're not only safe, but also designed to be active and good for you. So, there's no need for traditional parental controls.
However, if there's a game you'd rather your kids not play, you do have the ability to hide it. We know how it goes.
How can I be sure it's really, really safe? Play OS is a closed system built on top of Android Open Source Project, a modern and secure operating
system. We do not allow third-party software and do not run a web
browser, making it extremely safe.
PlayOS also went through a third-party security review, and we're KidSAFE+ COPPA Certified - not to brag or anything.
